libenclaveapp_clone_commit.scope: sshenc-tpm-bridge path dependency in the release workspace; not part of the v0.1 installed surface

policy.reason: Primary signing/key-management client used by the v0.1 reference integration.
Isolated per-user signing agent used by the v0.1 reference integration.
v0.1 uses `sshenc keygen --strong` through sshenc.exe instead of the standalone keygen binary.
Upstream gitenc couples signing configuration with Git SSH transport configuration, which violates the v0.1 transport-isolation boundary.
Native-Windows v0.1 does not use the WSL TPM bridge.
v0.1 does not use the upstream PKCS#11 integration path.

known_provenance_limits: Windows PE files in the selected release are not Authenticode-signed.
The sshenc release workflow references the reusable workflow through @main rather than an immutable SHA.
The historical run resolves that reusable workflow to commit 2fd3cf2594f8b9446004b73feef7ef2dd7954bdf.
The resolved reusable workflow uses floating runner/tool/action references including windows-latest and dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable.
Historical workflow logs were expired at audit time, preventing reconstruction of exact runner image and Rust stable version.
The release workflow performs an unpinned libenclaveapp clone used by the sshenc-tpm-bridge path dependency; that bridge binary is not part of the v0.1 installed surface.

forbidden_integrations.reason: Mutates Windows SSH/Git integration state, including stock ssh-agent and persistent environment integration.
Restores/removes upstream-managed Windows SSH/Git integration state outside hello-approval ownership.
Any gitenc.exe invocation is outside the v0.1 integration boundary because gitenc is designed to wrap Git transport as well as signing.
